_comment: PRIVATE FIELDS (24 Sep 2026). The rule that REFUSES private fields on the public record, built and tested (tests/rules/private-strict.test.mjs) but NOT deployed: old app binaries still write users/{uid}/dob at signup, and this would refuse their whole signup. Deploy it after the app writes dob to users_private/{uid}. To apply: delete the named children of users/$uid (they then fall to $other, which is .validate:false), and set the profile validate. See docs/APP-HANDOFF-PRIVATE-FIELDS.md.
